assets.name: atmosphere
assets.usage: Atmospheric ascent cloudscape, moving down behind the shuttle and fading toward Earth's limb at the orbital midpoint.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 1536x1024 environment painting for a pixel-art cyberpunk racing game during spacecraft launch and ascent through Earth's atmosphere. Raised rear chase-camera viewpoint looking diagonally upward through a vast blue atmosphere, brilliant layered white and pale cyan cloud banks sweeping along the far LEFT and RIGHT sides, hazy futuristic city tiny and far below at the bottom edge, strong feeling of climbing into the sky. Upper half is deep cobalt stratosphere becoming dark indigo at top with only a few stars; subtle curved bright atmospheric limb low in the frame. Central flight corridor from bottom center toward upper center must be spacious, low contrast and uncluttered so gameplay ships and four holographic lanes remain readable. Crisp detailed pixel art with visible small pixel clusters, sophisticated shade ramps, midnight navy shadows and restrained cyan-gold rim light, match retro cyberpunk game environment art. Cloud shapes should be natural volumetric towers with many shaded terraces and luminous tops, never simple circles. No ships, no people, no UI, no lane markings, no text, no logos, no space station, no watermarks. Full bleed opaque landscape.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art spacecraft sprite atlas for a cyberpunk Canvas 2D racing game. Create a square 2 by 2 atlas with four distinct civilian sci-fi traffic spaceships, each centered entirely in its own equal square cell with generous transparent padding. Top left: graphite courier with cyan engine accents. Top right: white armored executive shuttle with amber running lights. Bottom left: plum industrial cargo shuttle with magenta trim. Bottom right: weathered slate transport with teal engines. All four ships face RIGHT horizontally, seen from an elevated rear three-quarter view so top hulls and side profiles are readable, nose right, small engine glow left. Detailed restrained pixel art, crisp stepped edges, carefully shaded metal plates, vents, canopy glass, swept fins, compact thrusters; cohesive retro cyberpunk racing aesthetic. Strong clean silhouettes, civilian vehicles with no weapons, no turrets, no characters, no lettering, no labels, no borders, no grid, no ground, no shadows cast on background, no backdrop, no extra objects. Genuine transparent background around each ship, no haze. Each ship fits between 12 and 88 percent of its own cell width and 25 and 75 percent of its own cell height.

TOP ROW: four different clean futuristic SPACEPORT/HANGAR wall modules inspired by Star Wars spacecraft interiors, pristine ivory and cool light gray composite plating, deep graphite recessed vents, narrow vertical white light strips, tiny cyan status lights, precise segmented panels, recessed conduits. (1) tall angular white hangar bulkhead with a small sealed personnel door at bottom; (2) clean light-gray maintenance wall with black vertical vent banks and white light strips; (3) tall white flight-control wall with dark cyan panoramic observation windows and embedded technical panels; (4) clean off-white spacecraft airlock wall, octagonal beveled architecture, graphite recessed service panels. BOTTOM ROW: four CLOSED pairs of vertically tall sliding gate doors. Each cell entirely filled by its two symmetrical closed door leaves, a precise vertical center seam at 50%, no outer frame. (1) weathered Slums security gate, graphite and rusty copper plating, amber indicators, worn yellow-black lower warning strips; (2) pristine Downtown gate, white ceramic plating, pale cyan inlays and narrow brass accents; (3) high-tech spacecraft launch blast doors inspired by Star Wars, clean light-gray beveled interlocking panels, graphite diagonal recesses, bright white and ice-blue indicators, no rust; (4) Crystal Palace docking bay doors, luxurious pale ivory and brushed gold geometric panels, restrained turquoise status lights, sophisticated gold central seam. assets.name: character-design

Column 1 cyan runner: graphite slim armor, swept full helmet, TWO bright cyan parallel stripes; large full-body rear three-quarter view and small front and side thumbnails. Column 2 magenta runner: broad squared helmet, dark plum armor, ONE diagonal magenta stripe; large full-body rear three-quarter and small front/side thumbnails. Both use only one compact default pistol and a thin three-segment personal shield arc demonstrated beside them; no modules or gadgets. Column 3 cyan spaceship: compact slate wedge, twin cyan back stripes and twin cyan thrusters, nose visibly opposed to exhaust, small fixed forward cannon; large rear three-quarter view plus small top and side views. Column 4 magenta spaceship: broader plum wedge, diagonal magenta stripe, twin magenta engines, same simple fixed forward gun; large rear three-quarter plus small top/side views. Strict silhouette continuity from runner to their spacecraft. Header exact 'EDGERUNNER'. Column labels exact 'CYAN RUNNER', 'MAGENTA RUNNER', 'CYAN SHUTTLE', 'MAGENTA SHUTTLE'. No other text, no game UI, no watermark. Keep all drawings inside margins, equal prominence to both players.
